sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Wadhal has completed Wade House, a compact two-bedroom home in Ruislip , West London, on a brownfield site once occupied by two garages. At 70 square meters, the house meets the London Plan's minimum size for a two-bedroom dwelling and turns strict planning constraints into an opportunity for a more inventive model of suburban densification.
